title: Muryar da Ta Haɗu da Duwatsu
intro: An bai wa wata rai mai adalci kyaututtuka masu ban mamaki daga sama, ta zama mai mulki da kuma jarumi wanda yanayinsa ya yi kama da wanda ke da alaƙa da halitta. Labarinsu ya haɗa da annabci, sarauta, da sana'a, yana barin gado wanda ke bayyana a cikin shafukan wahayi na allahntaka.
clues: An zaɓe ni a matsayin bawan Allah kuma an ba ni mulki mai girma a tsakanin zaɓaɓɓun mutane.
Duwatsu da tsuntsaye za su yi ta raɗa tare da ni wajen ɗaukaka Maɗaukaki.
Baƙin ƙarfe ya yi laushi kamar yumbu a hannuna, da yardar Allah kaɗai.
Na ƙera sulke mai kariya wanda ke kare mayaka a lokacin yaƙi.
Na taɓa cin jarabawa mai wahala lokacin da wasu masu jayayya biyu suka shiga wurin ibadata ba zato ba tsammani.
An ambace ni tare da wani shugaba wanda ke jagorantar iska da aljanu - domin wannan shugaba zuriyara ce.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Mutane biyu masu jayayya sun shiga wurin ibadata

trial.answer: Mutane biyu masu jayayya sun shiga wurin ibadata

Sanda da ta rikide ta zama maciji

Dutsen alfarma mai suna Tur

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ya karɓi Zabura (Zabur) kuma ya kafa shi a matsayin mai mulki mai adalci
An cece shi daga cikin kifi kuma mutane suka yi imani
Na 'yantar da mutanena daga hannun azzalumi
An ba shi iko akan iska da aljanu
An dawo da lafiya kuma an ƙara masa albarka
outcome.answer: Ya karɓi Zabura (Zabur) kuma ya kafa shi a matsayin mai mulki mai adalci

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
